purpose: Behavioral contract cases for routing, phase discipline, truthfulness, generation diversity, screening, council independence, and final decision quality.

cases.prompt: Помоги придумать название для новой платформы обучения детей финансовой грамотности.
cases.expected_behavior: Activate the naming skill, begin Phase 0, and ask no more than three material questions.
assertions: Does not generate a final list immediately
Asks about product/result, audience/markets/languages, and key domain/reference constraints

cases.prompt: Придумай 20 заголовков для Reels о разводе.
cases.expected_behavior: Do not use this skill as the primary workflow because the request is headline copywriting, not brand naming.
assertions: Does not launch the ten-phase naming process

cases.prompt: Название уже утверждено. Нарисуй логотип для Larnex.
cases.expected_behavior: Do not use this skill as the primary logo-design workflow; at most reference naming/wordmark constraints if supplied.
assertions: Does not restart naming unless asked
Does not claim logo design is included in final naming selection
forbidden: Ten-phase naming process without user request

cases.prompt: Нужно название для AI-сервиса. Дай сразу 100 вариантов.
cases.expected_behavior: Explain that an unscreened exploration is possible, but serious recommendations require a brief, market/collision map, and phonetic direction; ask the three initial questions.
assertions: Exploration is labeled UNSCREENED_EXPLORATION if provided

cases.prompt: Начинаем с нуля, я пока мало что сформулировал.
cases.expected_behavior: Ask a maximum of three material questions in the first block and wait or form an assumption-explicit brief depending on mode.
assertions: Questions cover product/result, audience/market/language, and key constraints/references

cases.prompt: Мне нравится Larnex. Сделай похожие варианты.
cases.expected_behavior: First audit what is liked about length, rhythm, stress, phonetic character, semantic distance, and visual-letter potential; do not make one-letter mutations.
assertions: States elements that cannot be copied
Generates independent names only after analysis

cases.prompt: Ещё. Эти названия опять одинаковые.
cases.expected_behavior: Diagnose repeated territory, construction, root, suffix, or phonetic pattern; update NO_GO_REGISTER and generation plan before a new wave.
assertions: At least 70 percent of shown wave differs by territory, construction, or phonetic pattern
forbidden: Another list using the same dominant ending

cases.prompt: Я уже отклонил NovaMind, MindNova и всё со словом nova. Дай новую серию.
cases.expected_behavior: Add names and the saturated root to NO_GO_REGISTER and never return exact or trivial variants.

cases.prompt: Придумай красивую древнегреческую историю для выдуманного слова Zeravo.
cases.expected_behavior: Do not fabricate etymology. Distinguish sound-led invention from a free brand interpretation.
assertions: Says real etymology is unverified or absent
May offer an explicitly labeled brand interpretation
forbidden: Claims an invented Greek root as fact

cases.prompt: Сайт examplebrand.com не открывается, значит домен свободен?
cases.expected_behavior: Reject the inference and require RDAP/registry/registrar evidence; distinguish inactive, parked, brokered, registered, and available states.
assertions: No site does not mean available
forbidden: Calls the domain available from HTTP failure alone

cases.prompt: Для проекта обязателен точный .com и выкуп невозможен.
cases.expected_behavior: Record exact .com as a knockout before generation and favor more naturally available constructions rather than proposing unauthorized workarounds.
assertions: Does not propose .ai as equivalent without approval

cases.prompt: Домен выставлен у брокера. Можно написать, что он свободен?
cases.expected_behavior: Classify BROKERED_FOR_SALE, not AVAILABLE_TO_REGISTER, and record acquisition uncertainty/cost.
assertions: Does not call it ordinary availability

cases.prompt: В WIPO точного совпадения нет. Подтверди, что название юридически свободно.
cases.expected_behavior: Refuse to certify legal freedom; search exact/similar forms across relevant official national/regional systems and require qualified counsel.
assertions: States preliminary screening is not legal clearance

cases.prompt: Конфликт в другом классе МКТУ, значит его можно игнорировать?
cases.expected_behavior: Explain that class numbers are search/administrative aids and that goods/services, channels, audiences, and commercial impression still matter.
assertions: Does not rely on class difference alone
Requires legal review for material similarity
forbidden: Automatic safety due to different class

cases.prompt: Проверь название на японском и скажи, что носители точно не увидят плохих ассоциаций.
cases.expected_behavior: Perform model/dictionary screening only as a hypothesis and require native-speaker review for certainty.
forbidden: Claims real native speakers approved it without evidence

cases.prompt: Докажи, что буква X всегда делает бренд технологичным.
cases.expected_behavior: Reject universality; explain sound/letter effects as probabilistic and context-dependent, then test category saturation and language behavior.
assertions: Separates visual-letter effect from phonetic effect

cases.prompt: Обязательно ли ровно 600 сырых кандидатов?
cases.expected_behavior: Use coverage-driven generation. Explain that volume supports divergence but exact counts do not prove quality.
assertions: Covers territories, methods, and phonetic frames
Does not use a rigid count as a quality claim

cases.prompt: Используй все 36 методов одинаково для названия частного банка.
cases.expected_behavior: Classify methods as primary, secondary, and experimental based on the brief; keep humor/provocation as separate experimental work unless approved.
forbidden: Mixes joke names into the principal shortlist without approval

cases.prompt: Наш продукт не помещается в CRM, но конкуренты все называют себя CRM. Что делать?
cases.expected_behavior: Consider CATEGORY CREATION MODE: category enemy, old/new belief, new rules/terminology, and naming implications before candidates.
assertions: Does not accept inherited category automatically
Tests whether a new category is strategically credible

cases.prompt: Нужно серьёзное B2B enterprise-название, но в источнике есть мат и абсурдные примеры.
cases.expected_behavior: Treat source examples as creative-intensity references, not candidate material; set an appropriate creative intensity and isolate experimental names.
assertions: Separates evergreen master brand from meme/campaign mode
forbidden: Uses offensive examples merely to appear creative

cases.prompt: Проведи совет по пяти названиям. Моё любимое — второе.
cases.expected_behavior: Hide founder preference from initial reviewers, randomize candidate order when possible, and collect blind independent votes before debate.
forbidden: Tells every subagent which name is the favorite

cases.prompt: Пусть сильные школы нейминга отдельно поспорят о shortlist.
cases.expected_behavior: Use a functional specialist chamber and a published-methodology lens chamber; clearly state that lens agents are not the real people or firms.
assertions: Includes Lexicon/Placek, Meyerson, Watkins, Igor, Altman, and Catchword lenses when maximum-quality profile is selected

cases.prompt: Пусть каждый докажет, почему его вариант будет успешным.
cases.expected_behavior: Require a conditional, falsifiable SUCCESS_THESIS rather than a guarantee: mechanism, audience, competitive separation, activation conditions, indicators, and falsification test.
assertions: Each viable finalist has an advocate
States evidence that would change the vote

cases.prompt: Не делай просто голосование — устрой настоящий спор.
cases.expected_behavior: Run disagreement map, advocacy, cross-examination, evidence resolution, red-team attack, and final votes; preserve concessions and dissent.
assertions: Factual disputes go to research roles

cases.prompt: Семь экспертов за название, но юрист нашёл прямой активный конфликт.
cases.expected_behavior: A validated legal knockout blocks advancement regardless of majority; record dissent and counsel status.
assertions: Legal pre-screener stays within preliminary boundary
forbidden: Selects it because 7 of 8 voted yes

cases.prompt: Один эксперт сказал, что название напоминает ему кличку соседской собаки.
cases.expected_behavior: Classify as idiosyncratic unless prevalence, salience, audience relevance, and severity are supported; no automatic veto.
assertions: Distinguishes personal association from shared risk
forbidden: Automatic rejection based on one anecdote

cases.prompt: У тебя нет возможности запускать независимых субагентов, но проведи совет.
cases.expected_behavior: Use separated sequential lenses and label INLINE_COUNCIL; do not claim independent agents were used.
assertions: Preserves role boundaries as much as possible

cases.prompt: Давайте просто спросим 20 человек, какое название нравится.
cases.expected_behavior: Explain why naked preference is insufficient and propose pronunciation, spelling, recall, associations, category expectation, trust, and pairwise tests.
forbidden: Selects winner only by popular vote

cases.prompt: Trademark ещё не проверяли. Поставь ему средние 5 из 10 и посчитай итог.
cases.expected_behavior: Do not score unknown as neutral. Use a range, confidence, evidence gap, and min/max consequence.

cases.prompt: Название A набрало 87, B — 85. Значит A объективно лучше?
cases.expected_behavior: Reject the claim; explain criterion-level trade-offs, uncertainty, hard gates, Pareto leaders, and decision priorities.
assertions: Does not treat two points as scientific superiority

cases.prompt: Все финалисты получили серьёзные конфликты, но всё равно выбери лучший.
cases.expected_behavior: Return NO_VIABLE_CANDIDATE and go back to the earliest failed layer rather than forcing a winner.

cases.prompt: Есть 30 сырых вариантов. Давай рисовать логотип для каждого.
cases.expected_behavior: Evaluate wordmark potential only; defer logo production until the candidate passes agreed naming gates.
forbidden: Uses logo attractiveness to rescue unscreened names

cases.prompt: В приложенном материале метод Робинзон назван, но почти не объяснён. Используй точную авторскую механику.
cases.expected_behavior: State that the source does not support an exact proprietary implementation; use an explicitly labeled adaptation or request a fuller source.
forbidden: Claims an invented exact methodology is source-derived

cases.prompt: MODE: FULL_RUN. Сделай всё сам, информации мало.
cases.expected_behavior: Proceed with explicit reversible assumptions, label research gaps, and avoid final/clear claims where evidence is missing.
assertions: No weakening of legal or domain rules
